verses.text: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
lines: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

verses.text: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
lines: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer;
my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge;
my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

verses.text: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.
lines: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised;
and I am saved from my enemies.

verses.text: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.
lines: The cords of death surrounded me.
The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

verses.text: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.
lines: The cords of Sheol were around me.
The snares of death came on me.

verses.text: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.
lines: In my distress I called on Yahweh,
and cried to my God.
He heard my voice out of his temple.
My cry before him came into his ears.

verses.text: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.
lines: Then the earth shook and trembled.
The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken,
because he was angry.

verses.text: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.
lines: Smoke went out of his nostrils.
Consuming fire came out of his mouth.
Coals were kindled by it.

verses.text: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.
lines: He bowed the heavens also, and came down.
Thick darkness was under his feet.

verses.text: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
lines: He rode on a cherub, and flew.
Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

verses.text: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.
lines: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him,
darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

verses.text: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.
lines: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed,
hailstones and coals of fire.

verses.text: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.
lines: Yahweh also thundered in the sky.
The Most High uttered his voice:
hailstones and coals of fire.

verses.text: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them; Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.
lines: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them;
Yes, great lightning bolts, and routed them.

verses.text: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.
lines: Then the channels of waters appeared.
The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh,
at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

verses.text: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
lines: He sent from on high.
He took me.
He drew me out of many waters.

verses.text: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.
lines: He delivered me from my strong enemy,
from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

verses.text: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.
lines: They came on me in the day of my calamity,
but Yahweh was my support.

verses.text: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.
lines: He brought me out also into a large place.
He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

verses.text: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.
lines: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness.
According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

verses.text: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.
lines: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh,
and have not wickedly departed from my God.

verses.text: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.
lines: For all his ordinances were before me.
I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

verses.text: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.
lines: I was also blameless with him.
I kept myself from my iniquity.

verses.text: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.
lines: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness,
according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

verses.text: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.
lines: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful.
With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

verses.text: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
lines: With the pure, you will show yourself pure.
With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

verses.text: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.
lines: For you will save the afflicted people,
but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

verses.text: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.
lines: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh.
My God will light up my darkness.

verses.text: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.
lines: For by you, I advance through a troop.
By my God, I leap over a wall.

verses.text: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.
lines: As for God, his way is perfect.
Yahweh’s word is tried.
He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

verses.text: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,
lines: For who is God, except Yahweh?
Who is a rock, besides our God,

verses.text: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?
lines: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

verses.text: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.
lines: He makes my feet like deer’s feet,
and sets me on my high places.

verses.text: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
lines: He teaches my hands to war,
so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

verses.text: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.
lines: You have also given me the shield of your salvation.
Your right hand sustains me.
Your gentleness has made me great.

verses.text: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.
lines: You have enlarged my steps under me,
My feet have not slipped.

verses.text: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.
lines: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them.
I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

verses.text: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.
lines: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise.
They shall fall under my feet.

verses.text: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.
lines: For you have armed me with strength to the battle.
You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

verses.text: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.
lines: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me,
that I might cut off those who hate me.

verses.text: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.
lines: They cried, but there was no one to save;
even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.

verses.text: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.
lines: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind.
I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

verses.text: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.
lines: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people.
You have made me the head of the nations.
A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

verses.text: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.
lines: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me.
The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

verses.text: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.
lines: The foreigners shall fade away,
and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

verses.text: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,
lines: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock.
Exalted be the God of my salvation,

verses.text: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.
lines: even the God who executes vengeance for me,
and subdues peoples under me.

verses.text: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.
lines: He rescues me from my enemies.
Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me.
You deliver me from the violent man.

verses.text: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
lines: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations,
and will sing praises to your name.

verses.text: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
lines: He gives great deliverance to his king,
and shows loving kindness to his anointed,
to David and to his offspring, forever more.
